## POST /v1/crew/approvals/{approval_id}/decision

Answer an approval (embed credential only).

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | An embedded chat frame, with its embed credential. |

Public, embed credential only: accepts only the embed credential, and only for the connector conversation it is bound to. A delegated credential gets 403 approval_requires_first_party. Spends no quota and returns no quota headers. The first answer wins; later ones get 409 approval_already_resolved. The owner answers (including allow_always) through the Owner approval endpoint.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approval_id` | string | yes | apr_ id |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [ApprovalDecisionRequest](schemas.md#approvaldecisionrequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | `allow`, `deny` | yes |  |

Response `200`: Success.
